info.title: Cazana API
info.description:
Cazana public API.

⚠️ **Security Requirement:** You must use **TLS version 1.2 or greater**.

**API Key Requirement:** You will be provided with an API key which **must be sent in the request**.

**Production Endpoint:** `https://api.cazana.com`

**UAT Endpoint:** `https://api.cazana.com/uat`

api_key.description: To use any of our APIs you will need to provide the key that was given to you as a query parameter.
api_key.name: key

bearer.description: You can also provide your key as a Bearer token using the Authorization header.

get.description:
Returns the ABI (Association of British Insurers) code for a vehicle along with associated Thatchams security data.

The ABI code is an industry-standard identifier used across the insurance market to classify vehicles for rating and underwriting purposes. Insurance providers use this code to look up risk profiles and premium calculations.

Returns a 404 if no ABI data can be found for the provided identifier. Either a VRM or VIN must be supplied.

Analyses vehicle advertisement text from listings to extract and categorise features and characteristics mentioned in descriptions.

Returns classified lists of:
- **Features** — equipment and options identified in the listing text (e.g. heated seats, parking sensors, sat nav).
- **Modifications** — aftermarket changes noted in the advertisement.
- **Service History** — indicators of service records mentioned in the listing.

Each category includes a count and the specific matched keywords. Use the optional `date` parameter to restrict analysis to listings seen before a specific date. Accepts either a VRM or VIN.

parameters.name: vrm
parameters.description: VRM to search (required if `vin` not supplied)

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: VIN to search (required if `vrm` not supplied)

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Filter insights by date - insights will be calculated from results _before_ provided date.

get.description:
Performs a comprehensive vehicle history check, consolidating data from multiple sources into a single response with an overall risk assessment.

The overall `status` indicates one of three outcomes:
- **Pass** — no significant issues found.
- **Fail** — one or more serious issues detected (e.g. stolen, outstanding finance, scrapped).
- **Proceed with Caution** — minor concerns found that may warrant further investigation.

The response covers the following categories:

| Category | Details |
|---|---|
| **Finance** | Outstanding finance agreements registered against the vehicle, including lender name, contact number, agreement type, and term. |
| **Tax** | Current road tax status and expiry date. |
| **MOT** | Current MOT validity and expiry date. |
| **Legal** | High-risk markers, stolen vehicle status (with police force and report date), import and export flags. |
| **Damage** | Write-off and scrapped vehicle history with insurer details and loss type; VIC inspection results where applicable. |
| **Condition** | Insurance claim history, including claim dates and damage severity categories (e.g. Cat S, Cat N). |
| **Running Costs** | Estimated annual fuel and road tax costs based on the vehicle's specification. |
| **Cazana Data** | Market retail valuation and estimated current mileage. |
| **Buyer Info** | VIN, V5C issue date, and engine number. |
| **Eco & Environment** | CO2 emissions value, unit, and energy efficiency rating. |

Returns information about the dealer who most recently listed the vehicle for sale.

This is useful for identifying the current or most recent seller for a vehicle without needing to query full listing history. The response includes the dealer's business name, website, contact details (telephone, email, postcode), full address, and their classification as one of: **Franchise**, **Independent**, or **Supermarket**.

Returns a 404 if the vehicle has no associated dealer listing on record.

address.example: 4 City Road, Finsbury, London EC1Y 2AA, UK

get.description:
Returns Group Through Analysis (GTA) classification data for a vehicle.

GTA provides an industry-standard grouping and rate used by motor insurers to assess risk and determine premiums. The response includes the vehicle's make, model, trim, body style, and the associated GTA group and rate codes.

If no GTA data can be determined for the vehicle, the endpoint returns an empty JSON object (`{}`) rather than an error, to allow graceful handling in client applications.

Returns a list of image URLs for the vehicle.

By default, images from the vehicle's most recent listing are returned. If listing images are unavailable, the response falls back to manufacturer stock images based on the vehicle's specification.

Use the `type` parameter to explicitly request one source:
- `listings` — images from actual vehicle sale listings.
- `stock` — manufacturer stock images matched to the vehicle's specification.

Returns a 404 if no images are available for the vehicle.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter images by type (if not specified defaults to listings, then stock)

Provides the total number of previous owners, the date the current keeper acquired the vehicle, and details of prior keepers where available, including when each keeper acquired the vehicle. Accepts either a VRM or VIN.

get.description: Market Demand uses recent data to rank how well a vehicle sells relative to similar vehicles in its category. The score ranges from 0 to 100, with higher values indicating that similar vehicles in the market have recently sold well relative to how often they were listed.

Returns an estimated mileage for a vehicle.

The estimate is calculated based on the vehicle's known mileage history. Provide a `date` to estimate the mileage at a specific point in time; if no date is given, the estimate defaults to today's date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Estimation date, defaults to today's date if not specified

get.description:
Returns aggregated analytics derived from a vehicle's MOT history.

Provides summary statistics covering average annual mileage, pass and fail counts, average defect counts per test type (dangerous, major, minor, advisory), and annual failure rate. Also returns a breakdown of each individual MOT test with trends compared to the previous test.

Use the optional `date` parameter to restrict analytics to MOT tests completed before a specific date — the full list of MOT tests is still returned regardless.

This is version 1.0. For the latest version (v2.0), please [click here](#tag/2.0/operation/getMotFeatureSet2_0).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description:
Filter insights by date - insights will be calculated from results _before_ provided date.

**N.B. entire list of MOTs will still be returned**.

get.description:
Returns enhanced MOT analytics including per-year breakdowns, plate failure tracking, and support for filtering by current owner.

Extends the v1.0 response with additional aggregate counts such as total MOTs with dangerous, major, minor, or advisory defects, failed plate counts, and a `yearlyMotData` array providing per-year metrics with mileage-since-last-test calculations.

Use `currentOwnerOnly=true` to restrict the analytics to MOT tests performed while the current registered keeper has owned the vehicle. Note: the `averageAnnualMileage` field always reflects the vehicle’s full lifetime mileage regardless of this setting.

A 404 is returned if no MOT data is available for the vehicle or if data quality issues prevent the analytics from being computed.

parameters.name: vrm
parameters.description: VRM to search (required if `vin` not supplied)

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: VIN to search (required if `vrm` not supplied)

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Filter insights by date - insights will be calculated from results _before_ provided date.

parameters.name: currentOwnerOnly
parameters.description: Only include data for current owner

averageAnnualMileage.description: “Average Annual Mileage” field value is for the whole lifetime of the vehicle. This value is unaffected by “Current Owner Only” field setting.

get.description:
Returns MOT (Ministry of Transport) test history for a vehicle.

Each test record includes the test date, expiry date, odometer reading, pass/fail status, and a full list of any defects categorised by severity:
- **Dangerous** — immediate threat to road safety.
- **Major** — must be rectified before the vehicle is used on the road.
- **Minor** — should be repaired but does not prevent use.
- **Advisory** — items to monitor that may become defects in future.

Use `latest=true` to return only the most recent test result as a single object rather than an array.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Return only the latest MOT result as an object in `motData`

Options from different manufacturers are mapped to consistent Cazana codes and descriptions, enabling cross-manufacturer comparison of vehicle equipment. This is useful when comparing options across vehicles from different brands. Accepts either a VRM or VIN.

Returns the options and equipment that were actually fitted to the specific vehicle at the point of manufacture, identified at VIN level.

This provides build-specific data for the individual vehicle rather than derivative-level standard specifications, making it suitable for accurate vehicle descriptions and valuations. Each option includes a manufacturer code and description. Accepts either a VRM or VIN.

For a normalised view using Cazana's standardised coding, see the [Options Actual Coded](#tag/1.0/operation/getOptionsActualCoded) endpoint.

get.description:
Returns the standard factory options available for the vehicle's specific derivative.

Each option includes its availability status indicating how it was offered:
- **Standard** — included as standard on all vehicles of this derivative.
- **Optional** — available as a factory-fit option at additional cost.
- **Free** — included at no extra cost (typically a promotional option).

Accepts either a VRM or VIN. For a normalised view using consistent cross-manufacturer codes, see the [Options Standard Coded](#tag/1.0/operation/getOptionsStandardCoded) endpoint.

get.description:
Returns a chronological list of sale and listing events for a vehicle.

Each event represents a period during which the vehicle was advertised for sale and includes the first and last seen dates, asking price, dealer information, advertisement text, and photo URLs.

Use the `from` and `to` parameters to filter events within a specific date range based on the listing's `firstSeen` date. Note that providing date filters that result in no matching events will return a 404. Accepts either a VRM or VIN.

parameters.name: vrm
parameters.description: VRM to search (required if `vin` not supplied)

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: VIN to search (required if `vrm` not supplied)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only return listings with a `firstSeen` value after the date provided. *If no listings are found due to this query a 404 error will be thrown.*

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only return listings with a `firstSeen` value before the date provided. *If no listings are found due to this query a 404 error will be thrown.*

get.description:
Returns an enhanced set of sale and listing event data for a vehicle, extending v1.0 with additional fields.

Each event includes all the fields from v1.0 (first/last seen dates, asking price, dealer information, advertisement text, and photo URLs) plus:
- **Sold status** — whether the vehicle was confirmed as sold from this listing.
- **Original price** — the initial listing price before any reductions.
- **Active listing count** — the number of similar vehicles listed at the same time.

Use the `from` and `to` parameters to filter events by `firstSeen` date. Accepts either a VRM or VIN.

get.description:
Returns a market valuation for a vehicle. Either a VRM or VIN must be provided.

By default, the valuation is calculated for today's date at the vehicle's estimated mileage. The following optional parameters allow the valuation to be tailored:

| Parameter | Effect |
|---|---|
| `mileage` | Use a known mileage instead of the estimated value. |
| `date` | Calculate the valuation at a specific historical or future date. |
| `condition=poor` | Apply poor condition adjustment to return a trade-level value. |
| `confidence=true` | Include upper and lower confidence bands alongside the valuation. |
| `stockingDepreciation=true` | Include depreciation/appreciation data showing how the vehicle's value changes over days in stock. |

parameters.name: vrm
parameters.description: VRM to search

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: VIN to search

parameters.name: mileage
parameters.description: Vehicle mileage (if not specified it will be estimated)

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Valuation date, defaults to today's date if not specified

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Use "poor" condition for trade value

parameters.name: confidence
parameters.description: Get upper and lower confidence bands

parameters.name: stockingDepreciation
parameters.description: Get depreciation/appreciation of vehicle over days in stock

post.description:
Returns a paginated list of similar vehicles currently or recently listed for sale, matched to the specification of the queried vehicle.

Supports geographic search by postcode or latitude/longitude coordinates. Includes additional sort options including nearest mileage matching (`nearestMileage`), which finds listings closest to a target mileage value.

Use `showCriteria=true` to include the matching criteria used in the query, and `showFilters=true` to include available filter options for the result set.

⚠️ Vehicle categories shown in results are derived from advertisement text and are intended as an indication only. To verify a vehicle's category, use the `/check` endpoint.

showCriteria.description: A flag to return the criteria used to query the data

showFilters.description: A flag to return the filter options for the results set

sort.description: Sort listings by a particular characteristic. `distance` is measured in miles. When using `nearestMileage` the nearest mileage to `mileage.nearest` is sorted. If `mileage.nearest` is not passed in the request it will use the estimated mileage of the vehicle.

postcode.description: Optional but cannot be used if `longitude` and `latitude` are provided

longitude.description: Optional but must be used with `latitude` and cannot be used if `postcode` is provided.

latitude.description: Optional but must be used with `longitude` and cannot be used if `postcode` is provided.
